get_movie_credits.description: List the cast and crew credited on a film.
get_movie_credits.display_str_template: Get the cast and crew for TMDB film '{0}'.
get_movie_credits.name: get_movie_credits

parameters.description: The film's TMDB ID, as returned by Search films or What's trending.
parameters.name: movie_id

cast.description: The credited cast, in billing order

order.description: Their billing position -- 0 is top billing

department.description: Which department they worked in, for example 'Directing'

get_movie_details.description: Look up one film's full record: runtime, genres, budget, revenue, tagline, and its IMDb ID.

mock_response.overview: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets, is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task no one thinks is possible.
mock_response.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
mock_response.title: Inception

get_movie_details.name: get_movie_details

parameters.description: The film's TMDB ID, as returned by Search films or What's trending.
parameters.name: movie_id

parameters.description: Optional. Return titles and summaries in this language, for example 'en-US' or 'fr-FR'. Defaults to English.
parameters.name: language

backdrop_url.description: Direct link to the wide backdrop image, ready to use

budget.description: Production budget in US dollars, or 0 if unknown

imdb_id.description: The film's IMDb ID, for example 'tt1375666'

media_type.description: Whether this is a 'movie', a 'tv' show, or a 'person'

original_language.description: Two-letter code for the original language, for example 'en'

original_title.description: The title in its original language

poster_url.description: Direct link to the poster image, ready to use

production_companies.description: Names of the companies that produced it

release_date.description: When it came out, as YYYY-MM-DD. For TV this is the first air date.

release_status.description: Where the film is in production, for example 'Released', 'Post Production', or 'Planned'

revenue.description: Box office takings in US dollars, or 0 if unknown

runtime.description: How long the film runs, in minutes

tagline.description: The film's tagline, if it has one

title.description: The title. TMDB calls this 'title' for films and 'name' for TV, so both are read into this one field.

tmdb_id.description: The title's TMDB ID. Use with the film detail actions.

vote_count.description: How many users have rated it
